name: Dynamic Goniometer XR
summary:
Observe three-point angles and motion in mixed reality on Meta Quest 3 and 3S.

Dynamic Goniometer XR recognizes the supplied Original image, QR or ArUco targets. Auto selects one complete target family; explicit choices are also available. Place red M at the angle vertex, with green P and blue D forming the two arms. Keep all three visible.
